text: After their infant son Nic falls from a window while they make love, a grieving mother and her therapist husband [retreat to their isolated cabin in the woods, called Eden|trigger|travelling somewhere remote]. There he tries to treat her fear of nature, but [acorns pelt the roof, ticks feed on his hand and a fox speaks|threat|nature turning on us]. In the attic he finds her thesis on witch hunts, her handwriting turning frantic, and photographs that hint at [what was done to the boy|wrong|harm done to children].
